listing.description_html:
From first scribbles to first words, step by step.

This workbook follows the order teachers use: kids warm up with lines and shapes, then trace every letter A to Z and numbers 0 to 10, and finish by writing real words. Every letter page also has a big letter to color, and every word page has a picture to color, so practice never feels like homework.

  • Warm ups and shapes to build pencil control
  • A to Z in uppercase and lowercase, plus numbers 0 to 10
  • 20 picture words to trace and color
  • 20 sight words kids meet first in kindergarten
  • Dots on the center of each stroke, so kids trace the real letter shape
  • Free bonus pages: scan the code inside to print more at home

Perfect for Pre K, kindergarten prep and homeschool. Add it to your cart today!
